title: Oven Roasted Kenyan Egg Frittata
description: A briny and creamy Kenyan dish featuring caramelized sugar sauce, served in a stone bowl, perfect for a diabetic-friendly brunch.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, salt, black pepper, and smoked paprika.
In a small saucepan, caramelize the sugar over medium heat, stirring constantly.
Add the butter to the saucepan and stir until melted.
Add the chopped spinach to the saucepan and cook until wilted.
Pour the egg mixture into a greased stone bowl.
Add the wilted spinach mixture and crumbled feta cheese to the egg mixture.
Bake the frittata in the preheated oven for 25 minutes or until the eggs are set.
Remove the frittata from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Serve the frittata hot, garnished with additional spinach if desired.
